description: Use for clinical trial questions: registered trials from the atlas snapshot of ClinicalTrials.gov (trials whose intervention is named cannabis, a cannabinoid, cannabidiol, THC or a related medicine): identifier, title, status, phase, enrolment, conditions, countries, start date, the atlas compounds involved and the registry link, newest snapshot first. Intervention names that state an amount are left out. Titles are third party text. Educational reference, not medical advice. Example arguments: {"query":"epilepsy","limit":5}.

compound.description: Atlas compound id or name, for example "cbd".

condition.description: Atlas condition id, name or other name, for example "cancer", "glioblastoma" or "sleep": the trials the atlas counts for that condition (only conditions with a tally; the answer says when there is none).

limit.description: How many items to return, at most 25.

offset.description: Skip this many matching trials (for paging).

query.description: Words in the title, the conditions or the MeSH terms, for example "epilepsy" or "chronic pain".

name: list_trials
title: List registered trials
